labeling.evidence: inferred: Raw FAIMS data was converted into MzXML files with the FAIMS_MzXML_Generator tool (v1.0.7639, Hebert et al., 2018, Anal Chem) and queried with MaxQuant v 1.6.17.0 (FDR = 1%, match between runs = on) using the UniProt reference proteome database for human from may 2020 (canonical only, 20612 entries) and default settings for orbitraps.
